crossRefs.note: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer came, and the kings who were with him, and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim…
Now Joab fought against Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and took the royal city.
Therefore behold, the days come,” says Yahweh, “that I will cause an alarm of war to be heard against Rabbah of the…
You shall appoint a way for the sword to come to Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and to Judah in Jerusalem the…
But I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it will devour its palaces, with shouting in the day of battle…
A champion out of the camp of the Philistines named Goliath, of Gath, whose height was six cubits and a span went out.
Yet I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was like the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

people.name: Rephaim
people.line: A race of giants who inhabited Canaan

translations.web: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)
translations.bsb: (For only Og king of Bashan had remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. His bed of iron, nine cubits long and four cubits wide, is still in Rabbah of the Ammonites.)
translations.kjv: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
translations.asv: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.)
